question: Client assets per advisor across the five -- and is that comparison even valid?

cells.label: fact

items.text: Morgan Stanley reports advisor-led client assets, which represent client assets in accounts that have a Wealth Management representative assigned; the firm's total client assets also include self-directed and workplace channel assets.
items.quote: Advisor-led client assets represent client assets in accounts that have a Wealth Management representative assigned.
items.definition: client assets in accounts that have a Wealth Management representative assigned

items.text: Morgan Stanley's client assets (the broader measure) include financial advisor-led brokerage, self-directed brokerage, and workplace services among other services.
items.quote: Client assets represent those for which Wealth Management is providing services including financial advisor-led brokerage, investment advisory, custody, cash management, and administrative services; selfdirected brokerage and investment advisory services; financial and wealth planning services; workplace services, including stock plan administration, and retirement plan services.
items.definition: Client assets represent those for which Wealth Management is providing services including financial advisor-led brokerage, investment advisory, custody, cash management, and administrative services; selfdirected brokerage and investment advisory services; financial and wealth planning services; workplace services, including stock plan administration, and retirement plan services.

items.text: Morgan Stanley's self-directed client assets represent active accounts that are not advisor-led, with active accounts defined as having at least $25 in assets.
items.quote: Self-directed client assets represent active accounts which are not advisor-led. Active accounts are defined as having at least $25 in assets.
items.definition: active accounts which are not advisor-led; Active accounts are defined as having at least $25 in assets

items.text: Morgan Stanley's workplace channel includes equity compensation solutions for companies, their executives and employees, and stock plan unvested assets are not included in client assets.
items.quote: The workplace channel includes equity compensation solutions for companies, their executives and employees. Stock plan unvested assets are not included in client assets and represent the market value of public company securities at the end of the period, and excludes private company securities.
items.definition: workplace channel includes equity compensation solutions for companies, their executives and employees

items.text: Morgan Stanley reported total client assets (across Wealth and Investment Management) of $9.3 trillion at the end of 2025, and Wealth Management client assets of $8,084 billion (total) and $6,273 billion advisor-led at June 30, 2026.
items.quote: Total client assets in Wealth and Investment Management grew to $9.3 trillion

items.text: Morgan Stanley reported Advisor-led client assets of $6,273 billion and total client assets of $8,084 billion for Wealth Management at June 30, 2026.
Morgan Stanley's wealth management representatives were 15,950 at December 31, 2020, the count of representatives assigned in the advisor-led channel.

cells.reason: Passages give Morgan Stanley's own definitions of advisor-led client assets, client assets, self-directed assets, and workplace assets, plus representative and asset figures, which bear on whether per-advisor client asset figures can be compared across firms.

cells.label: different_quantity

items.text: Morgan Stanley reports fee-based client assets, a subset of advisor-led client assets, rather than any per-advisor client asset measure.
items.quote: Fee-based client assets represent the amount of assets in client accounts where the basis of payment for services is a fee calculated on those assets.
items.definition: amount of assets in client accounts where the basis of payment for services is a fee calculated on those assets

items.text: Morgan Stanley reports worldwide employees (83,728 at September 30, 2026) rather than a financial-advisor headcount in the cited metrics table.

cells.differs_because: Fee-based client assets is a subset of advisor-led client assets (the stated numerator proxy), not an assets-per-advisor figure; worldwide employees is a firmwide headcount rather than a financial advisor count.
cells.reason: Passages do not state a per-advisor client asset ratio or a directly comparable financial-advisor count, only the related advisor-led/fee-based asset measures and a firmwide employee count.
